review: Very tanky? Check High amount of coins with good rolls? Check Good damage and status application? Check She has it all. With her discard mechanics she will use s2 and s3 more consistently. Her passive boost her damage quite a bit and it counts shields damage too so she won’t have to tap out on her hp Her only problem is that in a sinking team she can burn out the count very easily with her high amount of coins and her full potential is locked behind uptie 4 Notable E.G.O. Synergy: Rime Shank - fuels it perfect and works well with her kit
